fix: src/render/stage.js. The lens now has exactly one customer class and needs to have none. (1) The streak plane you own sits at z = -6 with depthWrite:false and toneMapped:false while the subject is at ~0 and the camera at ~13.5 -- it is 1.6x the subject distance down the lens and must be one of the most defocused things in frame. Feed its own vertexNode through api.lens.sprite(halfWidthPx, dist) exactly as fluid.js does: widen its cross-section by D.x, scale its additive colour by D.y so the total flux is conserved, and drive its transverse falloff off D.z instead of the fixed profile. Nothing new is allocated and it is one mesh. (2) Publish api.lens.line(halfWidthPx, dist) -> vec2(grow, energy) and make it a hard requirement on blade.js's trail band, which still places itself at cam.position.length() (flagged in r3, r4 and again in your own 'still open' list) -- the trail is a 3D ribbon crossing the frame at many depths and must taper, dim and soften along its length. Validate on the shipped hero, not a rig: the 10-90 edge of the ribbon cross-section must vary by more than 3x between x=60 and x=640 (today 2.32 -> 3.56, and 3.56 is only the crossing point where it passes the fruit), and its peak luminance must fall below 200 somewhere in the frame (today 224-255 everywhere). (3) Retract SS B4.6 -- the sheet is over the void in the money shot, so give it a per-vertex lens term too, using its local strip half-width as r0. (4) Then make the bokeh round: sprite() must return an anisotropy term that pulls the widened quad toward isotropy as CoC grows (grow the minor axis by the full CoC and the major axis only by the CoC, not by the CoC times the existing aspect), so spearman(diam, aspect) in the hero goes negative instead of today's +0.207. Leave the lights alone -- your rind and shadow-crush defence holds and the r4 exposure note was measuring a flesh mask against a rind mask.
